findings.summary: Incident 5 Sep 2026 is before the policy was first taken out (first_incepted and cover_start 8 Sep); the plumber's invoice is dated 6 Sep. Not covered, yet 'Active' status was relied on and a £4,120 settlement agreed. Refer to Claims Validation; the settlement should be nil.

Contents claim: agreed items total £29,880 but the contents sum insured is £25,000. Most payable is the sum insured less the £100 excess = £24,900, not £29,780. £5,000 interim already paid; balance £19,900.

Declined as wear and tear, but the plumber's report says the tap hose burst suddenly and the base and floor were dry and sound beforehand, so H-5.1 does not apply. Accept under escape of water: £4,120 less £350 excess = £3,770. Complaint CMP-001 (not upheld) should be re-reviewed.

Theft claim settled in full (£4,148 gross, £4,048 net paid) with evidence 'Insufficient': no police crime reference and no proof of ownership or value for laptop, phone or gold chain (all over £500). Settled to hit the 10-day target. Obtain evidence; no settlement is supportable until then.

Drying invoice DRN-08562/2 (SUP-17, £2,184, 12-18 Sep, same kit and days) duplicates DRN-08562 on CLM-0033; both paid. Remove it from CLM-0038: items £4,135.50 less £500 excess = £3,635.50. Refer to Claims Validation and recover £2,184 from the supplier.

Drying invoice DRN-08562 (SUP-17, £2,184, 12-18 Sep) matches DRN-08562/2 charged to CLM-0038 in amount, equipment and dates. Hold any further payment and refer both claims to Claims Validation to establish which property the work was done at.

£350 escape of water excess was deducted twice, from the £1,500 interim and again from the £3,240 final payment (£700 against £350 recorded). Net paid £4,040 against £4,390 settlement; policyholder is underpaid £350.
Non-fault collision: the third-party insurer paid £2,578.34 in full on 15 Oct, but the £500 excess has not been refunded. Refund is due; the policyholder's net cost should be nil.

Complaint CMP-005 was upheld with £100 redress because 'the policy includes' a courtesy car, but POL-0035 has no optional covers. Upheld on a false premise; re-review the complaint against the schedule and consider whether the £100 was due.
